brain.commentary: Broad cross-asset stress and elevated institutional advisory risk warrant a defensive overlay despite all signals pointing long. Reduce exposure most where beta, volatility, or liquidity/institutional support are unfavorable. Fragile signals: NVDA due to very high beta and volatility; MSFT due to high volatility and weak liquidity; VTI due to negative alpha, poor liquidity, and strongly negative institutional factor score. QQQ is also vulnerable to stress because of elevated beta. SPY is the most robust signal but still merits a modest reduction.
